# Country house for sale

> A secluded estate of timeless elegance, set on approximately 97.22 hectares (240 acres) of picturesque Irish countryside with stunning views and approx. 1.65 km. Of frontage onto the river Nore. Featuring a historic main residence, a charming gate lodge, stables, woodlands, speciman trees and lush pastures, the estate also boasts a walled garden.

## Fakta
- Typ: country house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Plocha: 1003 m²
- Energetická náročnost: G
- Lokalita: Dysertmore Estate, Inistioge
- Cena: 3 950 000 €
